provenance.capturedBy: hand-transcribed from the incident writeup in DRO-1163; not an automated capture
provenance.note: Live evidence for this incident showed: the plugin's manifest registered all eight tools globally, per-run tool-gateway credentials were issued (ctx.runtimeMcp non-empty), but the codex_local adapter never attached the gateway MCP server, so no managed-tool session ever existed. The run's actual tools/list surface therefore contained only the adapter's default shell/resource-discovery tools -- none of this plugin's github_bot_* or slack_bot_* tools were present. This fixture encodes that observed tools/list content directly; it is intentionally NOT derived from this repo's manifest or tool-registration code, so it cannot silently track future registration changes.
